```{r}
#| label: setup

# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry

# Standard: key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
# NOTE: this post reads parquet inline for now. Follow-up (decision 0015): move

subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who             , ~cfb_athlete_id , ~gsis_id     ,
  "Shane Buechele" , "4039034"       , "00-0036679" ,

)
```

## 1. Introduction

Kyle Allen and Shane Buechele open the 2026 season as the Buffalo Bills'
backup quarterbacks, and this post follows both from their high-school
recruiting profiles through their college rosters to the NFL, to see how
two quarterbacks with different starting points reached the same role.

## 2. Data

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-08-27. Both players'
NFL careers are ongoing, so the NFL record runs through the 2026 roster and
may extend further.*
:::

### 2.1 Four records follow each player from high school to the NFL

The table defines the four records, each matched on the player's own id
rather than his name, so the trajectory cannot borrow a different player
with the same name.

```{r}
#| label: records-table
tibble::tribble(
  ~record                 , ~what_it_holds                                                                                                      , ~source                         ,
  "Recruiting profile"    , "Star grade (2 to 5), a 0 to 1 composite rating, and the national rank among all recruits in the high-school class" , "CFBD recruiting"               ,
  "College roster season" , "A season in which the player appears on a college team's roster, whether or not he played"                         , "CFBD rosters"                  ,
  "NFL roster season"     , "A season in which the player appears on an NFL club's roster, whatever his role"                                   , "nflverse rosters"              ,
  "Draft record"          , "A pick in the NFL draft; an NFL player with no draft record entered the league undrafted"                          , "CFBD and nflverse draft picks"
) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Record", "What it holds", "Source"),
    caption = "The four records behind each player's trajectory."
  )
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Kyle Allen arrived as the far higher-rated recruit

```{r}
#| label: recruiting-nums
#| include: false
# The recruiting id is an untrusted namespace (decision 0013); this direct
# filter is QA-verified for these two named players (the pin below checks the
# recruit name), not a general-purpose join.
recruits <- tbl(con, "recruiting") |>
  filter(playerId %in% !!subjects$cfb_athlete_id) |>
  select(
    playerId,
    recruit_name,
    hs_class,
    committed_to,
    recruit_position,
    stars,
    rating,
    national_rank
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  inner_join(subjects, by = c("playerId" = "cfb_athlete_id"))
rget <- function(who, col) recruits[[col]][recruits$who == who]

# Every quarterback recruit in the two players' classes, ranked within the
# class by national rank, so each profile is placed among its peers.
qb_pool <- tbl(con, "recruiting") |>
  filter(
    hs_class %in% !!recruits$hs_class,
    recruit_position %in% c("PRO", "DUAL"),
    !is.na(rating)
  ) |>
  select(recruit_name, hs_class, committed_to, stars, rating, national_rank) |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(hs_class) |>
  mutate(qb_rank = rank(desc(rating), ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(subject = recruit_name %in% subjects$who)
qb_rank_of <- function(who) qb_pool$qb_rank[qb_pool$recruit_name == who]
qb_n_of <- function(who) sum(qb_pool$hs_class == rget(who, "hs_class"))
```

Kyle Allen was a `r rget("Kyle Allen", "stars")`-star recruit ranked
`r fmt(rget("Kyle Allen", "national_rank"))` nationally and Shane Buechele
a `r rget("Shane Buechele", "stars")`-star ranked
`r fmt(rget("Shane Buechele", "national_rank"))`; the table sets the two
profiles side by side and the figures place each among every quarterback
recruit in his class.

```{r}
#| label: recruiting-origins
style_labels <- c(
  PRO = "Pro-style quarterback",
  DUAL = "Dual-threat quarterback"
)
recruits |>
  arrange(desc(stars)) |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    `High-school class` = hs_class,
    `Committed to` = committed_to,
    `Recruited as` = unname(style_labels[recruit_position]),
    Stars = stars,
    `Composite rating` = sprintf("%.4f", rating),
    `National rank` = national_rank,
    `Quarterback rank in class` = sprintf(
      "%d of %d",
      vapply(who, qb_rank_of, numeric(1)),
      vapply(who, qb_n_of, integer(1))
    )
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "High-school recruiting profiles. A lower rank is better; national rank counts all recruits in the class, quarterback rank only the rated quarterbacks, by composite rating."
  )
```

### 3.2 Both quarterbacks left their first school and finished college at a second

```{r}
#| label: build-spine
#| include: false
# Assemble the college->NFL spine (one row per player-season) with a
# data-backed draft status, keyed on athlete/gsis ids (decision 0015). Reads the
# published parquet on its cleaned schema (decision 0018); draft status comes
# from nfl_draft_picks.
spine <- player_trajectory(
  subjects,
  roster = tbl(con, "roster"),
  nfl_rosters = tbl(con, "nfl_rosters"),
  nfl_draft_picks = tbl(con, "nfl_draft_picks")
)

# Guard the spine before display enrichment: non-null who/team/stage, stage in
# {College, NFL}, complete logical `drafted` (decision 0005).
contract_player_trajectory(spine)

# Team brand colors + logos (display only, decision 0008). College teams come
# from teams.parquet; NFL clubs from nflverse, since teams.parquet is college
# only. `logo` columns are ESPN/CFBD image URLs.
#
# Pick the logo variant with better contrast on each tile from its luminance:
# dark tiles get the light ("dark-background") logo, light tiles the standard
# one. CFBD's columns are logo_light (/logos/, for light bg) and logo_dark
# (/logos-dark/, for dark bg); counter-intuitive, so key off luminance, not name.
rel_lum <- function(hex) {
  ok <- grepl("^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$", hex)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(hex))
  if (any(ok)) {
    m <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex[ok]) / 255
    lin <- ifelse(m <= 0.03928, m / 12.92, ((m + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
    out[ok] <- 0.2126 * lin[1, ] + 0.7152 * lin[2, ] + 0.0722 * lin[3, ]
  }
  out
}
college_meta <- tbl(con, "teams") |>
  select(team, color, logo_light, logo_dark) |>
  collect() |>
  transmute(
    team = team,
    name = team,
    color,
    logo = if_else(
      !is.na(rel_lum(color)) & rel_lum(color) < 0.5,
      logo_dark,
      logo_light
    )
  )
nfl_meta <- nflreadr::load_teams(current = FALSE) |>
  transmute(
    team = team_abbr,
    name = team_name,
    color = team_color,
    logo = team_logo_espn
  )
team_lookup <- bind_rows(college_meta, nfl_meta) |>
  distinct(team, .keep_all = TRUE)

spine <- spine |>
  left_join(team_lookup, by = "team") |>
  mutate(tooltip = paste0(name, " · ", season))

# Fail loudly at authoring time, before the post is frozen (decision 0015).
stopifnot(
  nrow(spine) > 0,
  all(subjects$who %in% spine$who),
  !anyNA(spine$color),
  !anyNA(spine$logo),
  # The caption's "neither was drafted" claim, backed by the draft-pick table:
  # fail the build if either player ever appears among drafted picks.
  !any(spine$drafted)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: path-nums
#| include: false
# One row per player summarising the college and NFL legs of the spine,
# bounded at 2026 so later refreshes cannot move the pinned counts.
path <- spine |>
  filter(season <= 2026) |>
  arrange(who, season)
college_leg <- path |>
  filter(stage == "College") |>
  group_by(who) |>
  summarise(
    college_seasons = n_distinct(season),
    n_schools = n_distinct(team),
    first_school = first(name),
    last_school = last(name),
    transfer_after = max(season[team == first(team)]),
    last_college = max(season),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
nfl_leg <- path |>
  filter(stage == "NFL") |>
  group_by(who) |>
  summarise(
    rookie_season = min(season),
    first_club = first(name),
    nfl_seasons = n_distinct(season),
    n_clubs = n_distinct(team),
    club_2026 = name[season == 2026][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
path_summary <- subjects |>
  left_join(college_leg, by = "who") |>
  left_join(nfl_leg, by = "who")
pget <- function(who, col) path_summary[[col]][path_summary$who == who]
```

The table lists each college career, and the figure shows every roster
season as a tile in team colors, with arrows at the transfer after
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "transfer_after")` for Allen and after
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "transfer_after")` for Buechele, and at the step
to the NFL with no draft pick in between.

```{r}
#| label: college-table
path_summary |>
  arrange(who) |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    `First school` = first_school,
    `Transferred after` = transfer_after,
    `Final school` = last_school,
    `Last college season` = last_college,
    `College roster seasons` = college_seasons
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Each player's college career from the roster records.")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-timeline

tl <- spine |>

a_xfer <- pget("Kyle Allen", "transfer_after") + 0.5

}
entry_label <- function(who) {
  sprintf(
    "Undrafted NFL entry:\n%s, %d",
    pget(who, "first_club"),
    pget(who, "rookie_season")
  )
}
p <- ggplot(tl, aes(x = season, y = who)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(

  annotate(

  ) +

  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = a_entry - 0.1,
    y = 0.42,
    xend = a_entry,
    yend = 0.64,
    curvature = -0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = b_xfer + 0.3,
    y = 2.78,
    label = xfer_label("Shane Buechele"),
    size = 4,

  ) +

girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 5)
```

### 3.3 Neither quarterback was drafted, and both stayed on NFL rosters into 2026 with the Bills

```{r}
#| label: nfl-nums
#| include: false
# Draft status checked in both draft sources, each on its own id namespace:
# CFBD picks on the college athlete id, nflverse picks on the NFL player id.
cfbd_draft_rows <- vapply(
  as.integer(subjects$cfb_athlete_id),
  \(id) {
    tbl(con, "picks") |>
      filter(collegeAthleteId == !!id) |>
      count() |>
      pull(n)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
nflverse_draft_rows <- vapply(
  subjects$gsis_id,
  \(id) {
    tbl(con, "nfl_draft_picks") |>
      filter(gsis_id == !!id) |>
      count() |>
      pull(n)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
path_summary$draft_rows <- cfbd_draft_rows + nflverse_draft_rows
nfl_positions <- tbl(con, "nfl_rosters") |>
  filter(gsis_id %in% !!subjects$gsis_id) |>
  distinct(gsis_id, position) |>
  collect()
```

Neither draft source holds a row for either player, yet the table and
figure show an NFL roster season for each in every year from entry
through 2026: `r pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons")` seasons with
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs")` clubs for Allen and
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons")` with
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs")` for Buechele.

```{r}
#| label: undrafted-entry
path_summary |>
  arrange(who) |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    `Last college team` = last_school,
    `NFL entry` = sprintf("%s, %d", first_club, rookie_season),
    `Draft records found` = draft_rows,
    `NFL roster seasons` = nfl_seasons,
    `NFL clubs` = n_clubs,
    `2026 club` = club_2026
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "NFL entry and NFL record through 2026. Draft records found counts matching rows in both the CFBD and nflverse draft-pick tables."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: nfl-fig
#| fig-height: 4
# One bar segment per contiguous stint with a club, placed on the season axis
# so the order of arrival reads left to right.
stints <- spine |>
  filter(stage == "NFL", season <= 2026) |>
  arrange(who, season) |>
  group_by(who) |>
  mutate(stint = cumsum(team != lag(team, default = ""))) |>
  group_by(who, stint, team, name, color) |>
  summarise(start = min(season), end = max(season), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(seasons = end - start + 1)
p_nfl <- ggplot(stints) +
  geom_rect_interactive(
    aes(
      xmin = start - 0.5,
      xmax = end + 0.5,
      ymin = as.integer(factor(who)) - 0.3,
      ymax = as.integer(factor(who)) + 0.3,
      fill = color,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s, %d to %d (%d season%s)",
        who,
        name,
        start,
        end,
        seasons,
        if_else(seasons == 1, "", "s")
      ),
      data_id = paste(who, stint)
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = (start + end) / 2, y = as.integer(factor(who)), label = team),
    color = "white",
    size = 4.4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2026) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(levels(factor(stints$who))),
    labels = levels(factor(stints$who))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "An NFL roster every season without a draft pick",
    subtitle = "NFL clubs by season through 2026, one segment per stint",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a segment for the club and its seasons."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
girafe(ggobj = p_nfl, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: nfl-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  # The "neither was drafted" claim, backed by both draft-pick tables and the
  # spine's own draft status: fail the build if either player ever appears.
  all(path_summary$draft_rows == 0),
  !any(spine$drafted),
  all(nfl_positions$position == "QB"),
  pget("Kyle Allen", "first_club") == "Carolina Panthers",
  pget("Kyle Allen", "rookie_season") == 2018,
  pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons") == 9,
  pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs") == 6,
  pget("Shane Buechele", "first_club") == "Kansas City Chiefs",
  pget("Shane Buechele", "rookie_season") == 2021,
  pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons") == 6,
  pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs") == 2,
  all(path_summary$club_2026 == "Buffalo Bills"),
  # an NFL roster season in every season from entry through 2026
  all(path_summary$nfl_seasons == 2026 - path_summary$rookie_season + 1)
)
```

## 4. Summary

The Bills' two backup quarterbacks started far apart in recruiting and
converged on the same path: two schools, no draft pick, and an NFL roster
every season since.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage       , ~`Kyle Allen`                                                                                               , ~`Shane Buechele`                                                                                                   ,
  "Recruiting" , sprintf("%d-star, national rank %s", rget("Kyle Allen", "stars"), fmt(rget("Kyle Allen", "national_rank"))) , sprintf("%d-star, national rank %s", rget("Shane Buechele", "stars"), fmt(rget("Shane Buechele", "national_rank"))) ,
  "College"    , sprintf("%s, then %s", pget("Kyle Allen", "first_school"), pget("Kyle Allen", "last_school"))               , sprintf("%s, then %s", pget("Shane Buechele", "first_school"), pget("Shane Buechele", "last_school"))               ,
  "Draft"      , "Undrafted"                                                                                                 , "Undrafted"                                                                                                         ,
  "NFL"        , sprintf("%d roster seasons, %d clubs", pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons"), pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs"))    , sprintf("%d roster seasons, %d clubs", pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons"), pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs"))    ,
  "2026"       , pget("Kyle Allen", "club_2026")                                                                             , pget("Shane Buechele", "club_2026")
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each player's path, stage by stage.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Neither recruiting profile led to a draft pick, a top-ten national rank included.

- Allen's national rank of `r fmt(rget("Kyle Allen", "national_rank"))`
  and Buechele's `r fmt(rget("Shane Buechele", "national_rank"))` ended
  at the same NFL entry point: undrafted, then on a roster the following
  season.
- Two careers are a case study, not a rate; how often highly rated
  quarterback recruits go undrafted is a question for the full population.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Going undrafted did not end either NFL career early.

- Both players have appeared on an NFL roster in every season since
  entering the league, Allen with `r pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs")` clubs
  in `r pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons")` seasons and Buechele with
  `r pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs")` in
  `r pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons")`.
:::

Several caveats bound these facts.

- A roster season records presence on a roster, not playing time,
  starts, or statistics, so the trajectory says where each player was,
  not how much he played.
- Both NFL careers are ongoing, so the NFL record is incomplete by
  construction.
- The recruiting rating is a single composite grade from the high-school
  class year and does not reflect later development.
